resolution.plan: The paper follows the Heron-Bench LLM-as-a-judge protocol (Inoue et al. 2024, arXiv:2404.07824) with gpt-4o-2024-05-13 as judge (temperature 0, seed 0), scoring answers relative to the benchmark's GPT-4 reference answers; the subject-model VQA prompt, the judge prompt and the reference answers live in the Heron-Bench release, whose URL is not printed in the paper (repo_url is the benchmark's known release). Answer the 102 Heron-Bench questions with gpt-4o-2024-05-13, judge with the same model, average 5 runs, and compare with 87.6 (Table 2; per-category values in Table 9).
resolution.approximation: Judge outputs are not fully deterministic even with seed 0 (footnote 14); subject and judge are the same model.
